calls.statement:
SELECT COUNT(*) as new_members
FROM dim_member
WHERE join_date = '2026-09-25'

SELECT join_date, COUNT(*) as member_count
FROM dim_member
WHERE join_date >= '2026-09-23' AND join_date <= '2026-09-27'
GROUP BY join_date
ORDER BY join_date

SELECT COUNT(*) as null_join_dates
FROM dim_member
WHERE join_date IS NULL

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) as distinct_members, COUNT(*) as total_rows
FROM dim_member
WHERE join_date = '2026-09-25'
